item.title: RUMOR: DAREDEVIL Star [SPOILER] Will Make MCU Return In SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day's street-level connections continue to expand, as a new rumour suggests that this fan-favourite Daredevil and Defenders star will make their MCU return next summer.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer Officially Released; Chris Evans Returns As Steve Rogers Next December!
item.description: Marvel Studios has officially released the first teaser trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, revolving around Chris Evans' long-awaited MCU return as Steve Rogers, a.k.a. Captain America.

item.title: ANT-MAN Star Paul Rudd Shows Off His Marvel PR Skills Answering AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Question From Travis Kelce
item.description: Paul Rudd, who’s starred as Ant-Man multiple times in the MCU, got a chance to show off his Marvel PR skills addressing Avengers: Doomsday during a conversation with Travis Kelce.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY First Poster Begins The Countdown To Doomsday...And Teases Doctor Doom's Magic Runes!
item.description: Marvel Studios has released the first poster for Avengers: Doomsday, and many fans are convinced that it's teasing Robert Downey Jr.'s MCU return as Doctor Doom.

item.title: ROGUE ONE Actor Calls STAR WARS Spin-Off Script “Surprisingly Unfinished;” Believes It Never Had A Final Draft
item.description: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story actor Mads Mikkelsen has revealed the film’s script was unfinished, stating he believes there was never a final draft for the project.

item.title: ANACONDA's Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As First Reviews Point To An Underwhelming Meta Reboot
item.description: The review embargo has lifted for the upcoming Anaconda remake starring Paul Rudd and Jack Black, but if its Rotten Tomatoes score is any indication, the movie is a swing and a miss.

item.title: Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers Will Reportedly Not Be The Captain America Of AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: Chris Evans is officially returning as Steve Rogers in 2026’s Avengers: Doomsday, but with a twist, as he will reportedly not be Captain America in the movie.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Passes $400 Million Worldwide On Track To $75M - $80M Holiday Weekend
item.description: To the surprise of no one, James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash will dominate the box office over the four-day Christmas weekend, and has already passed $400 million worldwide...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Reveal The Surprising Characters Trailers 3 & 4 Will Focus On - SPOILERS
item.description: We know that the second teaser for Avengers: Doomsday will focus on Thor, but a new rumor is claiming that the third and fourth trailers will spotlight some surprising characters... and teams!

item.title: James Ransone’s Wife Posts Touching Tribute To The IT: CHAPTER TWO And SINISTER Star Following His Passing
item.description: James Ransone’s wife posted a social media tribute to the actor, best known for his roles in Sinister and It: Chapter Two, following his passing by suicide at age 46.
